fields.v: No (0): the single author built Nerveplane, its planner (C1-PLAN) and its reactive conflict detection (C1-DETECT, a product primitive of Nerveplane); C0 is the absence of coordination, not an external approach, so every approach evaluated is the author's own
fields.quote: Tier A is a deterministic simulation that drives the real product primitives— agent registration, worktree sensing, conflict detection, and the planner core—over scripted scenarios, and scores the result with a real git integration.
fields.why: Both coordination arms are the author's own Nerveplane components and C0 is no coordination at all, so Partly (own approach compared with external ones) may not apply; the models are not the evaluated tool.
fields.doubt: Os dois braços com coordenação (C1-DETECT e C1-PLAN) são ambos do próprio Nerveplane do autor; o C0 é só ausência de coordenação, não uma abordagem externa. Vê a pág. 5 (§5) e decide se Q12 fica Parcial (modelos de terceiros contam) ou Não (todas as abordagens avaliadas são do autor).
